name: Elementor Website Builder
storage_notes: Global settings are individual wp_options prefixed elementor_ (field id + prefix rule in includes/settings/settings.php:165 and includes/settings/settings-page.php:264). The active Kit id is option elementor_active_kit. A Kit is an elementor_library post with _elementor_template_type=kit; Kit design settings live in _elementor_page_settings post meta. Per-page builder JSON lives in _elementor_data as a JSON string. Experiments are one option per feature named elementor_experiment-<name>. Generated CSS/assets live under wp-content/uploads/elementor and in meta _elementor_css, _elementor_page_assets and _elementor_element_cache.

settings.summary: Post ID of the active Kit document. Kit post type is elementor_library and _elementor_template_type is kit.
Post type slugs that Elementor may edit. Default is page and post; slug values are added as post type support 'elementor'.
CSS output mode: external file or internal embedding. Registered setting suffix css_print_method; changing it clears generated CSS.
Enables unfiltered uploads (SVG, JSON and other risky types). There is no separate elementor_allow_svg option in 4.3.6; SVG uploads depend on this switch plus SVG sanitization.

One option per experiment. Read state with Elementor\Plugin::$instance->experiments->is_feature_active(name); valid values are active, inactive and default. Built-in names include container, e_font_icon_svg, additional_custom_breakpoints, e_optimized_markup, e_optimized_css_files.
Element cache TTL in hours. Empty or non-numeric falls back to 24; the literal disable turns element caching off. Changing it clears the Elementor cache.
Disables Elementor default colors so theme colors are inherited. Stored as yes when enabled and empty/absent when disabled; change clears CSS.
Disables Elementor default fonts so theme fonts are inherited. Stored as yes when enabled and empty/absent when disabled; change clears CSS.
Loads Google Fonts from Google when 1; set 0 to stop Google Fonts loading.
CSS font-display value used for Google Fonts.
Serves Google Fonts locally. Change clears generated CSS; local font metadata is cached in option _elementor_local_google_fonts.
Adds fetchpriority/lazy loading optimizations. Option may be absent until saved; the settings field default is 1.
Dequeues unused Gutenberg editor assets. Option may be absent until saved; the settings field default is 1.
Lazy-loads background images except the first. Option may be absent until saved; the settings field default is 1.
Google Maps Embed API key used by the Google Maps widget.
Editor loader compatibility switch; empty is disabled and 1 is enabled.

meta.summary: Elementor element tree JSON for a page or template. Saved slashed; read returns the JSON string.
meta.format_notes: Encode with wp_json_encode then wp_slash before update_post_meta/update_metadata. Clear Elementor cache afterwards. REST meta schema exposes this as a string, not an array.

meta.summary: Page-level settings. On the active Kit this holds global colors, typography, layout, site identity and custom CSS.
meta.format_notes: Kit keys include system_colors, custom_colors, system_typography, custom_typography, container_width, space_between_widgets, page_title_selector, viewport_<breakpoint>, site_name, site_description, site_logo, custom_css. A direct meta write replaces the whole array; merge first. Save with wp_slash and clear cache.

meta.summary: Marks a post as built with Elementor.
meta.format_notes: Value is builder. Required for Elementor editing and REST meta registration context.

meta.summary: Document type for elementor_library posts. Free installations use page, section, container and kit; theme-builder types are Pro.
meta.format_notes: Must match a registered document type. For a Kit, value is kit. The elementor_library_type taxonomy mirrors this value (includes/template-library/sources/local.php:45).

meta.summary: Elementor version that saved the document; used for upgrade checks.
meta.format_notes: Written by Document::save_version(). Do not fabricate.
Generated cache; delete via clear_cache() rather than editing.
Generated cache; Document::delete_cache() or files_manager->clear_cache() removes it.

meta.summary: Display conditions for floating elements in free; Theme Builder conditions are Pro.
meta.format_notes: Example include/general. REST registration of this meta happens only when Elementor Pro is present (modules/wp-rest/classes/elementor-post-meta.php:26).

actions.name: get_active_kit_id
actions.summary: Read the active Kit post ID.

actions.name: update_kit_settings
actions.summary: Merge supplied keys into the active Kit settings and save; Kit::save clears the Elementor cache. A bare Document::save(['settings'=>...]) replaces the whole settings array.

actions.name: clear_cache
actions.summary: Delete generated CSS files and all Elementor CSS/element/assets meta, then fire elementor/core/files/clear_cache.

actions.name: set_experiment_state
actions.summary: Write elementor_experiment-<name> and clear the Elementor cache. In admin requests the registered update hook also validates dependencies and clears cache.

rest_routes.permission: manage_options; key must start with elementor
manage_options; key must start with elementor and value must be provided
edit_posts; excludes elementor_library and other forbidden post types

objects.storage: CPT elementor_library with _elementor_template_type=kit; active ID in option elementor_active_kit
objects.summary: Global design system document holding colors, typography, layout, site identity and custom CSS.
objects.crud_notes: Read ID from elementor_active_kit, then get_post_meta(id, '_elementor_page_settings', true). Create with Kits Manager create()/create_default_kit(); update through Kit::save(['settings'=>...]) or update_settings(); never edit _elementor_data for a Kit (Kit has no elements). Clear cache after direct meta writes.

objects.storage: CPT elementor_library; taxonomy elementor_library_type; meta _elementor_template_type and _elementor_data
objects.summary: Reusable page/section/container templates and Kit documents.
objects.crud_notes: List with WP_Query post_type=elementor_library. Create a library post, set _elementor_edit_mode=builder, _elementor_template_type, _elementor_data and the elementor_library_type term. Free does not include header/footer/single/archive theme-builder types.

objects.storage: Any post type with Elementor support; meta _elementor_data, _elementor_page_settings, _elementor_edit_mode
objects.crud_notes: Confirm post type is in elementor_cpt_support. Read _elementor_data JSON; update through Document::save(['elements'=>..., 'settings'=>...]) or write slashed JSON meta then clear cache. REST meta is available only for post types supporting elementor.

detection.active_check: defined('ELEMENTOR_VERSION') or class_exists('\Elementor\Plugin'); plugin basename ELEMENTOR_PLUGIN_BASE (elementor/elementor.php)

pro_notes: Theme Builder (header, footer, single, archive and their display conditions) is a Pro feature; free 4.3.6 only ships a Theme Builder promotion (modules/promotions/theme-builder-promotion.php:13) and registers _elementor_conditions in REST only when Utils::has_pro() is true (modules/wp-rest/classes/elementor-post-meta.php:26).
Pro-only document types and widgets are not included in this analysis; do not assume theme-builder document types exist on a free site.
gotchas: After writing _elementor_data, _elementor_page_settings or Kit settings, call files_manager->clear_cache(); otherwise external CSS and element cache are stale.
Elementor stores _elementor_data as a slashed JSON string, not as an array; direct meta writes must use wp_slash(wp_json_encode($data)).
The elementor/v1/settings/{key} POST route writes any option whose name starts with elementor with no type validation and does not itself clear cache; prefer typed settings or Document/Kit APIs.
The elementor/v1/post query route explicitly excludes elementor_library, so templates and Kits cannot be listed through it.
A Kit is an elementor_library post, not a separate post type; find it by elementor_active_kit and verify _elementor_template_type=kit.
Experiment options are per-feature; container defaults active only on new sites and may be inactive on upgraded sites. Read the actual option/state instead of assuming.
elementor_library post types are excluded from cpt_support by design; theme-builder locations are Pro, not a free fallback.
Editing the Kit site_name or site_description also updates the blogname/blogdescription options when saved through the Kit tab (core/kits/documents/tabs/settings-site-identity.php:144).
The unfiltered uploads switch enables SVG/JSON and is a security risk; Elementor still sanitizes SVG, but this should not be enabled casually.
